vo_open.text: This man may have saved the world.

vo.text: September 1983. Stanislav Petrov is on duty at a Soviet early-warning center.
vo.cap: *Sept 1983.* Stanislav Petrov, on duty. *Soviet early warning.*

vo.text: The alarm: a missile launched from the USA. Then up to four more.
vo.cap: *ALARM:* a missile from the USA. Then *up to 4 more.*

vo.text: Protocol said: report it. He decided it was a false alarm, and didn't.
vo.cap: Protocol: *report it.* He called it a *false alarm.*

vo.text: He was right. It was sunlight on clouds. Later, he was reprimanded, over paperwork.
vo.cap: He was *right.* Sunlight on clouds. Later: reprimanded... *over paperwork.*
